tasks.short: Compile the medical record for condition and treatment

steps.what: Read the research or cost control request for this episode
Read clinical documents of condition and treatment
Read the episode on the medical record screen
Draft the history abstract of condition and treatment

loop.input: Clinical documents of condition and treatment already stored for this episode
loop.check: A sentence stays only when it carries a mark tying it to one stored note. A sentence with no mark is dropped.
loop.stop: Stop when the draft is written, or when no note can be marked and the draft is empty. Do not wait for a person.
loop.why_not_simpler: The abstract is prose. Copying a stored field cannot write it.

steps.what: Ask the clinician about a missing treatment note
Maintain the episode dates on the medical record
Check each sentence against the treatment notes
Release the accepted history abstract into the medical record
Release the cost control extract for this episode
outputs: episode cost extract for this request

tasks.design: The specialist reads the request in {EMAIL}, the notes in {DOCS}, and the episode in the {OTHER} electronic health record. A bounded loop drafts the history abstract from the notes and stops when that draft is written. The specialist checks each sentence against the treatment notes, then releases that accepted abstract into the record, and separately releases a cost extract in {SPREADSHEET} for this request.
tasks.previous_blocker: The history abstract was written by reading every note, and filing it was the same act as judging it.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded loop can draft the abstract from notes already stored and stop before the specialist checks it.
tasks.still_hard: The specialist must still judge whether each sentence matches the treatment the notes describe.
tasks.human_edge: Only the specialist can accept that the abstract states the condition and the treatment the record supports.
tasks.altitude: The specialist still reads the notes, still checks every history abstract, and still releases it. The draft is the only part that no longer waits on them.

reach.task: Write the discharge and treatment notes the record is compiled from
reach.learn: Which note is the source for condition and treatment

evidence.claim: A bounded loop can draft a short history abstract from clinical notes that are already stored, and it can stop when the draft is written.
Health data are a special category under GDPR article 9.
Large-scale processing of health data requires a data protection impact assessment.
A medical dossier is kept for 20 years, and a patient may ask who viewed it.

assumptions: Largest remainder on the means prior gives screens 36, spreadsheets 4, mail 3, documents 48 and meetings 9. The document points are split into reading 28, drafting 6, checking 10 and releasing 4. That split is a design choice, not a measured study.
The treating clinician already stored the notes. If the text is not stored, the loop does not run and the specialist writes the abstract.

The draft reads only the clinical documents. It does not wait for the clinician answer or for the check. The check names accepted history abstract v1. The release files that version and does not edit it.

Episode maintenance is dates and ward on the record. The specialist writes that version in the same step, because no machine draft precedes it. The cost extract is built for this request from the filed abstract and that maintenance, and it is not sent outside the hospital in this task.

The check is the steady-state upkeep and its hours are already in that step, so incremental focal hours are zero. The loop sees only the episode text it needs, under the hospital's own access rules. It does not infer emotion.
unknowns: Whether a research or cost extract is allowed to leave the hospital.
research_questions: Whether condition and treatment are stored as text notes or as structured fields.

already_counted.description: Checking each sentence of the history abstract against the treatment notes is the specialist's review and is already in that step.

incremental.description: No extra steady-state upkeep. The review time is already counted on the check.

approvals.approved_version: episode cost extract for this request

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When the notes are missing, the loop writes nothing and the specialist drafts by hand, so the low is 0. When the notes are stored, only the draft step goes away and the check stays, so the high is 4, under the draft's 6.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Code patient data with a standard classification

steps.what: Read this patient's episode header in the record
Read the clinical text for this patient
Read the standard classification for this episode
Read mail about this patient's coding question
Draft an abstract of classification codes for this patient

loop.input: The clinical text for this patient and the standard classification list for this episode
loop.check: A code stays only when it matches an entry on the classification list. A code that is not on the list is dropped.
loop.stop: Stop when the draft is written, or when no passage maps to a list entry and the draft is empty. Do not wait for a person.
loop.why_not_simpler: Choosing a code from prose is not a copy of a stored field.

steps.what: Ask the clinician about this patient's diagnosis
Check each proposed code against this patient's text
Release the accepted classification codes for this patient

tasks.design: The specialist reads the clinical text in {DOCS} and the standard classification on the {OTHER} electronic health record. A bounded loop drafts proposed codes from that text and stops when the draft is written. The specialist checks each code against the patient's text, then releases the accepted codes on the record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Suggesting a code and judging it were one pass, so a draft could not exist before the specialist decided.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded loop can propose codes from stored clinical text and stop when the draft is written.
tasks.still_hard: A code can be on the list and still name the wrong condition.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist decides whether each code matches the condition the text documents.
tasks.altitude: The specialist still checks every proposed code against the patient's text and still releases the codes. Episodes with thin text are still coded in full by hand.

reach.role: Health Information Technologists and Medical Registrars
reach.task: Keep the classification list the codes are drawn from
reach.learn: Which list version this episode must use

evidence.claim: DHD codes day admissions to ICD-10 from clinical text in 32 hospitals.
DHD reports that 65% of day admissions were coded with high certainty, that codes above 70% skip the coder, that those codes were 85 to 90% correct, and that Rijnstate was 72% automatic.
A coder still has to judge whether a proposed code matches the condition written in the text.
Recording consultations or logging coder corrections can count as staff monitoring under the Works Councils Act article 27(1)(l).
Software with a medical purpose is a medical device.
Health data are a special category under GDPR article 9.

assumptions: Largest remainder on the means prior gives screens 49, spreadsheets 4, mail 3, documents 39 and meetings 5. The spreadsheet points are folded into the record-screen reads because the classification and the episode are already on the record. That is a disagreement with the prior, not a new baseline.
The document points are split into reading 24, drafting 6 and checking 9. That split is a design choice, not a measured study.

The registrar already keeps the classification list. The draft uses that list and the clinical text. It does not wait for the clinician answer or for the check. The check names accepted classification codes v1. The release writes that version and does not edit it.
The DHD day-admission percentages are provider figures. They are not this task's time saving, and they do not shorten the check.

This design does not log the specialist's corrections as a staff record. The loop sees only the episode text it needs, under the hospital's own access rules. It does not infer emotion. The check is the upkeep and its hours are already counted, so incremental focal hours are zero.
unknowns: Whether this hospital's code suggestion is classed as a medical device.
research_questions: Whether the classification stores a code list the loop can read.

already_counted.description: Checking each proposed code against this patient's text is the specialist's review and is already in that step.

incremental.description: No extra steady-state upkeep. The review time is already counted on the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When the text will not support a proposal, the specialist codes the episode in full and the low is 0. When a draft is produced, only that draft step goes away and the check stays, so the high is 4, under the draft's 6. The day-admission percentages in the digest are not this range.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assign the patient to a diagnosis related group

steps.what: Read stored diagnosis codes and discharge facts
Read the grouper factors for this diagnosis
Read the episode documents behind this diagnosis
Read the mail about this patient's group
Assign the diagnosis related groups as a software proposal
Ask the clinician about the principal diagnosis
Check the proposed group against the diagnosis
Release the accepted care group for this patient

tasks.design: The specialist reads stored diagnosis codes and the grouper factors on the {OTHER} electronic health record, and the episode documents in {DOCS}. The grouper software, already in use, writes a proposal and stops there. The specialist checks that proposal against the diagnosis, then releases the accepted care group. No loop writes the group.
tasks.previous_blocker: The specialist keyed the grouper and accepted its result in the same sitting.
tasks.enabler_now: The grouper can write a proposal from stored codes and stop before anyone accepts it.
tasks.still_hard: The principal diagnosis is a clinical judgement the grouper does not make.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist accepts the care group only when it matches the principal diagnosis and the procedures.
tasks.altitude: The specialist still checks every care group against the principal diagnosis and still releases it. The grouper no longer waits for them to key it and accept it in one sitting.

reach.task: State the principal diagnosis the grouper will use
reach.learn: Which diagnosis the episode is led by

evidence.claim: Grouper software assigns a care group from diagnosis codes, procedure codes, age and discharge status that are already stored.
A medical dossier is kept for 20 years, and a patient may ask who viewed it.
Health data are a special category under GDPR article 9.

assumptions: Floors of the means prior sum to 99. Mail and meetings both have remainder 0.4, and the last point goes to meetings because its raw share 3.4 is larger than mail 1.4. The 2 spreadsheet points are folded into the record-screen reads because the codes are already on the episode. The steps then use screens 58, mail 1, documents 37 and meetings 4. That fold is a disagreement with the prior, not a new baseline.
The O*NET statement names diagnosis-related groups. A European hospital assigns its own care-product group with the grouper it already runs. This design does not invent a field list for that grouper.

The codes are the coder's already released set. If those codes are missing, the grouper does not run. The proposal uses the stored codes, the discharge facts and the factor table. It does not wait for the clinician answer or for the check.

The check names accepted care group v1. The release writes that version and does not edit it. Running the grouper that already exists earns no extra labour saving beyond the keying step. The check is the upkeep and its hours are already counted, so incremental focal hours are zero.
unknowns: Which national grouper this hospital runs, and which fields it reads.
research_questions: Whether principal diagnosis, procedures, age and discharge status are already fields on the episode.

already_counted.description: Checking the proposed group against the diagnosis is the specialist's review and is already in that step.

incremental.description: No extra steady-state upkeep. The review time is already counted on the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When diagnosis codes are not already stored, the grouper does not run and the low is 0. When they are stored, only the keying of the proposal goes away and the check stays, so the high is 4, under the proposal's 8.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare business or government health forms

steps.what: Read the mail that asks for these forms
Read the portal requirements for these forms
Read episode facts needed for these government forms
Read the business correspondence for these forms
Copy stored facts into these government forms
Draft the free text reason on these forms

loop.input: The business correspondence and the episode facts for this form
loop.check: A sentence stays only when it carries a mark tying it to one sentence in the correspondence or one stored episode fact. An unmarked sentence is dropped.
loop.stop: Stop when the draft is written, or when nothing can be marked and the draft is empty. Do not wait for a person.
loop.why_not_simpler: The reason is prose. Copying stored fields cannot write it.

steps.what: Ask the clinician about a fact these forms need
outputs: clinician answer on a form fact

steps.what: Check each field and sentence on these forms
inputs: clinician answer on a form fact

steps.what: Prepare and send the accepted government forms

tasks.design: The specialist reads the request in {EMAIL}, the blank requirements on {GOV_PORTAL}, the episode facts in the {OTHER} electronic health record, and the correspondence in {DOCS}. Stored facts are copied onto the form, and a bounded loop drafts only the free-text reason. Each stops before the check. The specialist checks every field and sentence, then sends that accepted version through {GOV_PORTAL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: The form was prepared and sent as one act, so the text could change after it was checked.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored facts can be copied, and a loop can draft the reason, both before a separate check and a separate send.
tasks.still_hard: A missing source field or an overstated reason still has to be caught by the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist sends a form only when every field matches the episode and the reason states only what the record supports.
tasks.altitude: The specialist still checks every form and still sends the accepted version. The copy and the reason draft finish before that check.

reach.task: Receive a record request that becomes one of these forms
reach.learn: Which facts the request is allowed to ask for

evidence.claim: When episode facts are already stored as fields, a configured copy can place those fields on a form and stop before anyone checks them.
A bounded loop can draft a free-text reason from correspondence and stop when that draft is written.
Health data are a special category under GDPR article 9.
Large-scale processing of health data requires a data protection impact assessment.

assumptions: Largest remainder on the means prior gives screens 42, spreadsheets 4, mail 3, documents 44 and meetings 7. The spreadsheet points are folded into the record-screen reads because the form facts come from the episode. The steps then use screens 46, mail 3, documents 44 and meetings 7. That fold is a disagreement with the prior, not a new baseline.

The screen points include the portal read, the episode read, the field copy and the send. The document points are split into correspondence 20, the reason draft 5 and the check 19. Those splits are a design choice, not a measured study.
Test whether the record already copies statutory fields before adding code. The copy is configuration. The reason still needs a loop. If a source field is missing, the copy does not run.

The blank requirements already exist on the portal. The copy and the reason draft do not wait for the clinician answer or for the check. The check names accepted health form v1. The send transmits that version and does not edit it.

The statement is business or government forms, and the exposure mode is outside the care team, so the send leaves the organisation. An internal-only form would stay an internal write. The loop sees only the episode text it needs, under the hospital's own access rules. It does not infer emotion. The check is the upkeep and its hours are already counted, so incremental focal hours are zero.
unknowns: Which government form this is, and whether the recipient is a public body or an insurer.
research_questions: Which facts on the form are stored fields and which are free text.

already_counted.description: Checking each field and sentence on these forms is the specialist's review and is already in that step.

incremental.description: No extra steady-state upkeep. The review time is already counted on the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When the form's facts are not stored as fields, the copy does not run and the specialist prepares the form by hand, so the low is 0. When the fields are stored, the copy and the reason draft go away and the check and the send stay, so the high is 6, under the combined 11.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The specialist still checks every history abstract, every code, every care group and every form, and still releases each one. The shorter work is the draft of the abstract, the draft of the codes, the grouper proposal and the form text.
reach: Health Information Technologists and Medical Registrars
skills_to_grow: Judging whether a proposed code matches the documented condition
Judging whether a form states only what the episode supports
role.ambitious_version: The specialist still releases every code and every form that leaves the hospital.
